title: Cold rebuild: ship a pasted one-liner
summary: Expand a one-liner full of aliases into a script that runs the same on every machine, from memory.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: In *Aliases: fine to type, wrong to ship* you turned a pasted one-liner into a script that runs anywhere. Do it again
from memory: same scenario, **no hints, no solution**, the same checks. Getting stuck is useful news: go back to the
lesson, then try again tomorrow. This check and the boss prove the module.

steps.prompt: Which of these is the analyzer **unable** to fix for you with `-Fix`?
steps.explain: `PSAvoidUsingCmdletAliases` rewrites aliases. Abbreviated parameter names are not aliases, so you spell those out yourself (Tab completion does it as you type).

steps.title: Spell out a pasted one-liner, cold
prompt: Make `~/scripts/report-logs.ps1` production-ready: no aliases (by PSScriptAnalyzer), `-Descending` spelled out, and
exactly the same output as before.
From memory: no hints this time.
